mechanics.claim: Vex's next basic attack (which becomes non-projectile) or basic ability hit against an enemy with Gloom detonates the mark for bonus damage and CDR.
mechanics.quote: '''Vex's''' next {{tip|basic attack}}, which becomes {{tip|projectile|non-projectile}}, or basic ability hit against an enemy with ''Gloom'' will detonate the mark

mechanics.claim: Looming Darkness (E) also inflicts Gloom on hit, but cannot itself detonate an existing mark.
mechanics.quote: ''{{ai|Looming Darkness|Vex}}'' will also inflict ''Gloom'', but cannot detonate it.

mechanics.claim: Doom's cooldown begins as soon as the empowered basic ability is cast, not when it lands.
mechanics.quote: ''Doom's'' cooldown starts as soon as the basic ability is cast.

mechanics.claim: Spell Shield blocks all of Doom's effects but does not block Gloom's empowered attack or the mark itself.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will block all of ''Doom's'' effects but not ''Gloom's'' empowered attack nor mark.

mechanics.claim: A Gloom mark about to expire refreshes to 0.5 seconds when Vex starts an attack windup against that target.
mechanics.quote: ''Gloom's'' mark duration will refresh to {{fd|0.5}} seconds when '''Vex''' starts an attack windup against a target that has a mark which is about to expire.
